items.exampleEn: My mother gets along very well with her daughter-in-law.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽和她的媳婦相處得很好。

items.exampleEn: My father-in-law still calls me every Sunday to ask about the kids.
items.exampleZh: 我岳父每個星期天都還會打電話問孩子們的近況。

items.exampleEn: Ask a grown-up to help you cross the street.
Few habitants remain in the mountain town now that the mine has closed.
items.exampleZh: 礦場關閉後，這個山城剩下的居民不多了。

items.exampleEn: My mother-in-law gave us her old piano as a wedding gift.
items.exampleZh: 我婆婆把她的舊鋼琴送給我們當結婚禮物。

items.exampleEn: I am meeting my sister-in-law for lunch tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 我明天要和我的姻親姊妹一起吃午餐。

items.exampleEn: At the wedding, the bride's father warmly welcomed his new son-in-law.
items.exampleZh: 婚禮上，新娘的父親熱情地歡迎他的新女婿。

items.sentenceEn: My mother-in-law and I often go shopping together on weekends.
items.sentenceZh: 我和婆婆週末常常一起去購物。

items.audioEn: My son-in-law is coming to dinner, so I'm cooking his favorite dish.
items.audioZh: 我女婿要來吃晚餐，所以我在煮他最愛吃的菜。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼煮女婿最愛的菜？
options: He is moving away next week

items.sentenceEn: This house was built forty years ago by my wife's father, my father-in-law.
items.sentenceZh: 這棟房子是我太太的父親、也就是我岳父，在四十年前蓋的。

items.sentenceEn: When I was a child, I couldn't wait to be a grown-up.
items.sentenceZh: 我小時候，迫不及待想當大人。

items.stemEn: My older brother's wife is my ____, and she lives in Kaohsiung.
items.stemZh: 我哥哥的太太是我的嫂嫂，她住在高雄。

items.stemEn: In my family, my wife is my parents' ____.
items.stemZh: 在我家，我太太是我爸媽的媳婦。

items.passageEn: Every Chinese New Year, the Lin family has a big dinner. Grandma Lin's son-in-law cooks the fish, her daughter-in-law makes the rice cakes, and her sister-in-law, the wife of her older brother, brings dessert. The grown-ups talk at the big table, while the children play in the garden. Grandpa Lin is always punctual and makes everyone sit down at six. This year, Grandma's own mother-in-law, who is ninety-five, also came. She said the family reminded her of the habitants of her old village, where everyone shared their food.
items.passageZh: 每年過年，林家都會吃一頓豐盛的年夜飯。林奶奶的女婿負責煮魚，媳婦做年糕，她的嫂嫂（她哥哥的太太）帶甜點來。大人們在大桌子旁聊天，孩子們在花園裡玩。林爺爺總是很準時，六點一到就要大家坐下。今年，林奶奶九十五歲的婆婆也來了。她說這一家人讓她想起從前村子裡的居民，那裡的人總是互相分享食物。

questions.questionZh: 林奶奶的婆婆說這一家人讓她想起什麼？
options: 她年輕時在城裡一家餐廳做過的工作
一部講大家庭過年的老電影
從前村子裡互相分享食物的居民

items.promptZh: 我的嫂嫂是一位很有耐心的老師。
referenceEn: My sister-in-law is a very patient teacher.
My sister-in-law is a teacher with a lot of patience.
rubricZh: sister-in-law 指嫂嫂、弟媳等姻親姊妹，複數是 sisters-in-law
「很有耐心的」可寫 very patient、with a lot of patience 等

items.promptZh: 這部電影小孩和大人都很喜歡。
referenceEn: Both children and grown-ups enjoy this movie.
This movie is loved by kids and grown-ups alike.
rubricZh: grown-up 當名詞，表示「大人」，這裡用複數（例如 grown-ups 等）
「都很喜歡」可寫，例如 Both … and … enjoy、is loved by … alike 等
「小孩」可寫，例如 children、kids 等；時態可用現在式或過去式
